title: Enhancing role of small, medium businesses in Azerbaijani economy is one of priorities, Agency says

facts.fact: Azerbaijan marks the "Entrepreneur's Day" on April 25, a day established upon the president's order in 2016, according to the Azerbaijani Agency for Development of Small and Medium Businesses.
facts.quote: Azerbaijan marks the "Entrepreneur's Day" on April 25, established upon the order of the president in 2016

facts.fact: About 99 percent of business entities in Azerbaijan are micro, small and medium-sized businesses, per the Agency for Development of Small and Medium Businesses.
facts.quote: Currently, about 99 percent of business entities in Azerbaijan are micro, small and medium-sized businesses.

facts.fact: As of January 1, 2021, 92.1 percent of registered business entities in Azerbaijan were micro-businesses.
facts.quote: As of January 1, 2021, 92.1 percent of registered business entities are micro-businesses

facts.fact: As of January 1, 2021, 5.3 percent of registered business entities in Azerbaijan were small businesses.
facts.quote: 5.3 percent - small businesses and 2.1 percent - medium-sized businesses

facts.fact: As of January 1, 2021, 2.1 percent of registered business entities in Azerbaijan were medium-sized businesses.
facts.quote: 5.3 percent - small businesses and 2.1 percent - medium-sized businesses

facts.fact: The number of registered individual entrepreneurs engaging in entrepreneurial activity without a legal entity exceeded one million people during the reporting period.
facts.quote: the number of individual entrepreneurs registered to engage in entrepreneurial activity without creating a legal entity exceeded one million people.

facts.fact: Under the Cabinet of Ministers resolution of December 21, 2018, microentrepreneurs have up to 10 employees and annual income of up to 200,000 manat ($117,647).
facts.quote: entrepreneurs with up to 10 employees and an annual income of up to 200,000 manat ($117,647) are considered microentrepreneurs

facts.fact: Under the Cabinet of Ministers resolution dated December 21, 2018, small businesses have 11 to 50 employees and annual income from 200,000 manat ($117,647) to three million manat ($1.8 million).
facts.quote: those with the number of employees ranging from 11 to 50 people and an annual income of 200,000 manat ($117,647) to three million manat ($1.8 million) - small business

facts.fact: Under the Cabinet of Ministers resolution dated December 21, 2018, medium-sized businesses have 51 to 250 employees and annual income from three million manat ($1.8 million) to 30 million manat ($17.6 million).
facts.quote: those with the number of employees from 51 to 250 people and an annual income from three manat ($1.8 million) to 30 million manat ($17.6 million) - medium-sized businesses

facts.fact: 75 percent of the income of individual entrepreneur microentrepreneurs and of legal-entity microentrepreneurs is exempt from tax.
facts.quote: 75 percent of the income of individual entrepreneurs - microentrepreneurs and 75 percent of the income of legal entities - microentrepreneurs are exempt from tax.

facts.fact: Microentrepreneurs are exempt from property tax, except those whose fixed assets have a residual value above 1,000,000 manat ($588,235) at the beginning of the year.
facts.quote: microentrepreneurs (with the exception of those whose fixed assets have a residual value of more than 1,000,000 manat ($588,235) at the beginning of the year) are exempt from property tax.

facts.fact: Micro and small business entrepreneurs holding a Startup Certificate are exempt from income tax and innovation-income tax for three years from the certificate's receipt date.
facts.quote: exempt from income tax and tax on income from innovation activity for a period of three years from the date of receiving the Startup Certificate

facts.fact: Public procurement of goods, work or services with an approximate value of $3 million or less is carried out only through e-procurement with SME participation, using an open tender method.
facts.quote: public procurement of goods (work, services) with an approximate value of $3 million or less is carried out only through e- procurement

facts.fact: The "Friend of SMEs" network operates in 24 cities and districts of Azerbaijan.
facts.quote: the "Friend of SMEs" (small-medium enterprises) network operating in 24 cities and districts of the country.

facts.fact: Development Centers of SMEs are located in Baku, Sumgayit, and the Khachmaz, Sheki and Yevlakh districts.
facts.quote: Development Centers of SMEs located in Baku, Sumgayit cities, Khachmaz, Sheki and Yevlakh districts.

facts.fact: Houses of SMEs are located in the Khachmaz and Yevlakh districts.
facts.quote: Houses of SMEs located in Khachmaz and Yevlakh districts.
